title: Same-Day Cancellation Fee Amount — Appointment Series Financial Policy
content:
Patient financial policy — amount clause for same-day cancellations on an Appointment Series.

**Clause.** The same-day cancellation fee is the same-day basis, and the same-day basis is the late-cancellation fee of the series' visit format. The cent rounding is done a single time, on the finished amount.

**Records read.** The visit format of the series and that format's late-cancellation fee.

**Example (hypothetical figure).** A format late-cancellation fee of USD 60.00 gives a same-day basis of USD 60.00 and a same-day cancellation fee of USD 60.00.
